products.name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Chicago Lost & Found'
products.description: The grail colorway returns with vintage-inspired details. Featuring premium cracked leather collars, aged sail midsoles, and classic Chicago red-and-black overlays. Every pair is 100% verified authentic by Woodpeckers Ghana.
products.reserveGuidance: Estimated Reserve: ~GH₵ 3,200 - GH₵ 3,500. Submit your best offer to secure.

products.name: Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low 'Reverse Mocha'
products.description: Cactus Jack's signature inverted oversized swoosh paired with premium sail leather and rich earth-toned mocha suede. One of the most sought-after low-tops in global sneaker culture, brought directly to Accra.
products.reserveGuidance: Estimated Reserve: ~GH₵ 4,400 - GH₵ 4,800. Fast manual or rule-based review.

products.name: Nike Dunk Low Retro 'Panda'
products.description: The quintessential monochrome daily sneaker. Clean black-and-white leather blocking engineered to complement any streetwear fit or casual luxury aesthetic effortlessly.

products.name: New Balance 9060 'Sea Salt & Rain Cloud'
products.description: Futuristic design meets unmatched Y2K runner cushioning. ABZORB and SBS cushioning pods sculpted with an exaggerated wavy sole and breathable diamond mesh upper.
products.reserveGuidance: Estimated Reserve: ~GH₵ 1,850 - GH₵ 2,000. Open for competitive buyer offers.

products.name: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Carbon Beluga'
products.description: Full-length BOOST midsole wrapped in Primeknit with bold solar-red SPLY-350 side stripe. Unmistakable streetwear icon engineered for all-day comfort.
products.reserveGuidance: Estimated Reserve: ~GH₵ 2,400 - GH₵ 2,650. Verified authentics only.

products.name: Woodpeckers Heavyweight Oversized Tee 'Accra Night'
products.description: Crafted from 280 GSM luxury combed cotton with dropped shoulders, high-density ribbed collar, and minimal subtle tonal Woodpeckers branding on the chest.

products.name: Woodpeckers Tactical Cargo Pants 'Obsidian'
products.description: Structured water-repellent ripstop fabric with adjustable ankle toggles, ergonomic 3D cargo pockets, and industrial matte hardware. Tailored specifically for sneakerhead silhouettes.
products.reserveGuidance: Estimated Reserve: ~GH₵ 700 - GH₵ 780. Premium tailored cut.

products.name: Woodpeckers Signature Boxy Hoodie 'Raw Ivory'
products.description: 450 GSM French Terry loopback cotton. Pre-shrunk with a double-layered hood without drawstrings for a pure architectural streetwear profile. Warm, bold, and made to last.
products.reserveGuidance: Estimated Reserve: ~GH₵ 780 - GH₵ 880. Ultra-heavy French Terry.

products.name: Asics Gel-Kayano 14 'White & Pure Gold'
products.description: 2000s technical running aesthetic recontextualized for modern lifestyle wear. GEL technology cushioning delivers shock absorption while metallic gold accents bring elevated prestige.
